title.speaker: announcer
title.text: Wasteland Racers! Press the space bar to start your engines!

pick-driver.speaker: announcer
pick-driver.text: Who's driving today? Pick your racer!

garage-hello.speaker: announcer
garage-hello.text: Welcome to the garage! Fix up your car, then hit RACE!

not-enough.speaker: announcer
not-enough.text: Race some more to get enough scrap for that one!

upgrade-engine.speaker: announcer
upgrade-engine.text: Vroom vroom! A bigger engine! Your car is faster now!

upgrade-tires.speaker: announcer
upgrade-tires.text: Grippy new tires! Now you can zoom around the corners!

upgrade-armor.speaker: announcer
upgrade-armor.text: Tough new armor! Now you won't spin out for as long!

upgrade-gadget.speaker: announcer
upgrade-gadget.text: More gadget power! You can hold more gadgets now!

maxed.speaker: announcer
maxed.text: That one is all the way full! Awesome!

new-car.speaker: announcer
new-car.text: Whoa! A brand new ride! Looking tough!

new-gadget.speaker: announcer
new-gadget.text: A new gadget! In a race, press the space bar to use it!

decal-locked.speaker: announcer
decal-locked.text: Win a whole wasteland to get that sticker!

locked.speaker: announcer
locked.text: Win the race before this one to open it up!

lead.speaker: announcer
lead.text: You're in first place! Keep it up!

jump-2.speaker: announcer
jump-2.text: Whoa! Look at that car fly!

gadget-hint.speaker: announcer
gadget-hint.text: You got a gadget! Press the space bar to use it!

got-spun.speaker: announcer
got-spun.text: Whoa! Shake it off and keep going!

tow.speaker: announcer
tow.text: Here comes the tow drone! Back on the road you go!

place4.speaker: announcer
place4.text: You finished the race! Every race earns scrap!

scrap.speaker: announcer
scrap.text: Look at all that scrap! Let's go to the garage!

new-track.speaker: announcer
new-track.text: A new race track is open!

new-world.speaker: announcer
new-world.text: A whole new wasteland is open! And you got a new sticker!

champion.speaker: announcer
champion.text: You beat everybody! You are the Wasteland Champion!

rex-intro.speaker: rex
rex-intro.text: Rawr! I'm Rusty Rex! Bet you can't catch me!

rex-lose.speaker: rex
rex-lose.text: Aw, rust buckets! You're super fast!

muffler-intro.speaker: muffler
muffler-intro.text: Ahoy! Captain Muffler's the king of this junkyard!

muffler-lose.speaker: muffler
muffler-lose.text: Shiver me bolts! You beat me fair and square!

bertha-intro.speaker: bertha
bertha-intro.text: Ha ha! Hope you like goo, sweetie, 'cause here it comes!

bertha-lose.speaker: bertha
bertha-lose.text: Ha ha ha! Well, I'll be! You're a real racer!

warlord-intro.speaker: warlord
warlord-intro.text: HONK HONK! The Warlord rules the volcano road!

warlord-lose.speaker: warlord
warlord-lose.text: HONK! Wow! You're the best driver I've ever seen!

dome-intro.speaker: announcer
dome-intro.text: Welcome to the Thunder Dome! It's the biggest race of all!

blower.speaker: announcer
blower.text: Hit the blower! Feel that V8 roar!

stomp.speaker: announcer
stomp.text: STOMP! Big Foot shakes the ground!

caltrops.speaker: announcer
caltrops.text: Spikes on the road! Watch out!

doublev8.speaker: announcer
doublev8.text: Double V8! The Gigahorse is unstoppable!

bikes.speaker: dementus
bikes.text: Go, my lovely bikes! Go get them!

spikes.speaker: announcer
spikes.text: Spike ram! Nobody touches the Buzzard!

got-wrecked.speaker: announcer
got-wrecked.text: Wrecked! Shake it off, you're back in it!

new-lore-car.speaker: announcer
new-lore-car.text: A real Wasteland legend! Shiny and chrome!

not-enough-chrome.speaker: announcer
not-enough-chrome.text: Win more races to earn chrome for that one!

ornament.speaker: announcer
ornament.text: Ooh, a hood ornament! Very fancy!

valhalla.speaker: announcer
valhalla.text: Welcome to the Valhalla Book! Collect them all!

card-locked.speaker: announcer
card-locked.text: Keep racing to unlock this card!

fury-intro.speaker: furiosa
fury-intro.text: This is the Fury Road. Drive fast, and don't look back.

slit-intro.speaker: slit
slit-intro.text: You're on the Fury Road now. I'm coming for you!

slit-lose.speaker: slit
slit-lose.text: Grr! You drive like a real War Boy!

rictus-intro.speaker: rictus
rictus-intro.text: Rictus wants to race! Rictus is the biggest!

rictus-lose.speaker: rictus
rictus-lose.text: Aww! Rictus lost! Can we race again?

card-max.speaker: max
card-max.text: My name is Max. I drive the Interceptor.

card-furiosa.speaker: furiosa
card-furiosa.text: I'm Furiosa. I'm taking the War Rig to the Green Place.

card-nux.speaker: nux
card-nux.text: Witness me! I'm Nux, and I'm awaited in Valhalla!

card-warpup.speaker: warpup
card-warpup.text: I'm a War Pup! Someday I'll drive a War Rig!

card-doof.speaker: announcer
card-doof.text: The Doof Warrior! He rocks the whole Fury Road!

card-joe.speaker: joe
card-joe.text: I am Immortan Joe! I am your redeemer!

card-dementus.speaker: dementus
card-dementus.text: Do you have it in you to make this epic?

card-rictus.speaker: rictus
card-rictus.text: Rictus! Big and strong! Rictus is the biggest!

card-slit.speaker: slit
card-slit.text: I'm Slit. Out of my way, I'm a lancer!

card-bulletfarmer.speaker: bulletfarmer
card-bulletfarmer.text: I'm the Bullet Farmer! Nobody gets past my farm!

card-peopleeater.speaker: peopleeater
card-peopleeater.text: The People Eater counts everything! Every drop of guzzoline!

comic-c1-1.speaker: joe
comic-c1-1.text: I am Immortan Joe! Only the fastest drivers may ride in my War Party!

comic-c1-2.speaker: announcer
comic-c1-2.text: The War Boys have spotted a new racer. That's you!

comic-c1-3.speaker: nux
comic-c1-3.text: You drive like a War Boy! Let's ride to Valhalla!

comic-c2-1.speaker: peopleeater
comic-c2-1.text: Every drop of guzzoline belongs to Gas Town! Want some? Race for it!

comic-c2-2.speaker: furiosa
comic-c2-2.text: We need that guzzoline. Stay close and keep the raiders off my Rig.

comic-c2-3.speaker: announcer
comic-c2-3.text: Here comes the Doof Wagon! Turn it up!

comic-c3-1.speaker: bulletfarmer
comic-c3-1.text: Nobody gets past my farm! Not tonight!

comic-c3-2.speaker: announcer
comic-c3-2.text: The Peacemaker is coming! Watch for the red circles!

comic-c4-1.speaker: furiosa
comic-c4-1.text: We're going to the Green Place. Out past the storm.

comic-c4-2.speaker: joe
comic-c4-2.text: She took my War Rig! Bring it back! War Party, ride!

comic-c4-3.speaker: nux
comic-c4-3.text: Oh what a day! What a lovely day!

comic-c5-1.speaker: dementus
comic-c5-1.text: My horde rides! Gas Town is mine now!

comic-c5-2.speaker: dementus
comic-c5-2.text: Do you have it in you to make this epic?

comic-end-1.speaker: announcer
comic-end-1.text: The Wasteland is free! Water for everybody!

comic-end-2.speaker: nux
comic-end-2.text: Shiny and chrome! Shiny and chrome!

comic-end-3.speaker: announcer
comic-end-3.text: You are the Road Warrior of the whole Wasteland!

ev-c1-race.speaker: nux
ev-c1-race.text: Race me around the Citadel! Witness me!

ev-c1-chase.speaker: slit
ev-c1-chase.text: You'll never outrun the War Party!

ev-c1-arena.speaker: announcer
ev-c1-arena.text: Citadel Pit Smash! Grab the most guzzoline!

ev-c2-race.speaker: slit
ev-c2-race.text: Back for more? This is my town now!

ev-c2-escort.speaker: furiosa
ev-c2-escort.text: The Rig is full of guzzoline. Keep the raiders away.

ev-c2-doof.speaker: announcer
ev-c2-doof.text: Doof Run! Hit the boost pads on the beat of the drums!

ev-c3-race.speaker: rictus
ev-c3-race.text: Rictus wants a rematch! In the dark!

ev-c3-arena.speaker: announcer
ev-c3-arena.text: Mine Pit Smash, in the dark! Follow your headlights!

ev-c3-chase.speaker: max
ev-c3-chase.text: Night raid. Drive fast. Don't stop.

ev-c4-escort.speaker: furiosa
ev-c4-escort.text: This is it. The Fury Road. Keep the War Party off the Rig.

ev-c4-storm.speaker: nux
ev-c4-storm.text: Into the storm! Oh what a day!

ev-c4-bog.speaker: max
ev-c4-bog.text: The Bog. Watch out for the crow people on stilts.

ev-c4-chase.speaker: furiosa
ev-c4-chase.text: Buzzards in the canyon! Go, go, go!

ev-c5-chase.speaker: dementus
ev-c5-chase.text: My horde will catch you! Ride, my lovelies!

ev-c5-arena.speaker: dementus
ev-c5-arena.text: Gas Town is mine! Come and take it!

boss-rictus-intro.speaker: rictus
boss-rictus-intro.text: Rictus! Rictus wants to SMASH you with Big Foot!

boss-rictus-dazed.speaker: announcer
boss-rictus-dazed.text: He hit the tires! Now's your chance, hit him!

boss-rictus-down.speaker: rictus
boss-rictus-down.text: Rictus is tired. You win, little racer.

boss-peopleeater-intro.speaker: peopleeater
boss-peopleeater-intro.text: Welcome to my refinery! Mind the fire, it's very expensive!

boss-fire.speaker: announcer
boss-fire.text: Fire jets! Watch out for the glowing stripes!

boss-peopleeater-hurt.speaker: peopleeater
boss-peopleeater-hurt.text: My tanker! Do you know what that costs?

boss-peopleeater-down.speaker: peopleeater
boss-peopleeater-down.text: Fine! Take the guzzoline! Take it all!

boss-bulletfarmer-intro.speaker: bulletfarmer
boss-bulletfarmer-intro.text: I can't see you, but I can hear you! Here comes the thunder!

boss-incoming.speaker: announcer
boss-incoming.text: Red circles! Steer out of the circles!

boss-joe-intro.speaker: joe
boss-joe-intro.text: Bring back my War Rig! War Party, attack!

boss-wheel.speaker: announcer
boss-wheel.text: A wheel is glowing! Ram it!

boss-joe-hurt.speaker: joe
boss-joe-hurt.text: My Gigahorse! Fix it, War Boys!

boss-dementus-intro.speaker: dementus
boss-dementus-intro.text: Behold my chariot! Catch me if you can, little racer!

boss-bike.speaker: announcer
boss-bike.text: That bike is glowing! Knock it loose!

boss-dementus-down.speaker: dementus
boss-dementus-down.text: Well... that was epic. You win.

chase-start.speaker: announcer
chase-start.text: The War Party is right behind you! Get to the finish!

chase-escaped.speaker: announcer
chase-escaped.text: You escaped! They'll never catch you now!

escort-start.speaker: furiosa
escort-start.text: Stay close to the Rig. Keep the raiders off!

escort-hit.speaker: furiosa
escort-hit.text: They're hitting the Rig! Get them off!

arena-start.speaker: announcer
arena-start.text: Grab the guzzoline cans! Most cans wins!

world-hello.speaker: announcer
world-hello.text: Welcome to the Wasteland! Follow the arrow to your next adventure!

world-patrol.speaker: announcer
world-patrol.text: War Boys spotted you! Wreck them or drive away!

world-card.speaker: announcer
world-card.text: You found a secret Valhalla card!

world-locked.speaker: announcer
world-locked.text: Finish the chapter before this one to open it!

chapter-open.speaker: announcer
chapter-open.text: A new chapter of the Wasteland is open!

boss-ready.speaker: announcer
boss-ready.text: The boss is waiting for you! Drive to the skull!
